description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing 'Codes' in the system, including endpoints to retrieve, create, update, and delete code entities. It leverages JAX-RS annotations for REST operations and Swagger annotations for API documentation. The class interacts with underlying services to perform CRUD operations and provides serialization of responses.

classes.name: CodesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for operations related to codes, including CRUD endpoints.

methods.name: retrieveCodes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all codes, with optional query parameters for serialization settings.

methods.name: createCode
methods.description: Handles POST requests for creating a new code, expecting JSON request body.

methods.name: retrieveCode
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a code by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveCodeByName
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a code by its name.

methods.name: updateCode
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a code's details by ID.

methods.name: deleteCode
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a code by ID.
